## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND signals lower fear while Credit Stress rising (Credit Spread 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND — mixed confirmations justify NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX falling (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND. Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +0.67%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND reflecting strain. Reflation bid: CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND vs GLD (1W: -4.19% | 1M: +1.68%) CORRECTION.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar modestly firmer: UUP (1W: +0.30% | 1M: -0.84%) RECOVERY. Rates a touch higher: TLT (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.43%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve ↓ falling, keeping conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Leadership mixed and narrow: XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY and XLU (1W: +0.16% | 1M: -2.81%) RECOVERY showing relative strength, while XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION show short-term weakness — style mixed, no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US lagging slightly on the week: SPY (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION; EM outperformance vs US: EEM (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%) ABOVE TREND and Europe steady: VGK (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +4.04%) NEUTRAL; China FXI (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -2.36%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Spec appetite easing: IWM (1W: -2.35% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; IBIT (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +2.37%) NEUTRAL. VXX decline supports lower realized fear but breadth remains narrow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND driving commodity strength; GLD (1W: -4.19% | 1M: +1.68%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -0.65% | 1M: +22.66%) CORRECTION show metals volatility and profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY but oil benchmarks weak: BNO (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.98%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) BELOW TREND — watch energy dispersion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: VXX falling and CPER ABOVE TREND provide two independent confirmations of calmer volatility and reflation pressure. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR Divergence present — SPY (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION show 1W vs 1M mismatches across core ETFs, suppressing a strong regime call.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective cyclicals and energy exposure: XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY, monitor XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION for confirmation; reduce exposure to short-term tech momentum: XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and speculative ARKK (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; bonds neutral: TLT (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.43%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY if CPER momentum holds. BEARISH: Technology XLK (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%) CORRECTION and small caps IWM (1W: -2.35% | 1M: +0.56%) CORRECTION on continued risk off pulses.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.98%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency reference) — VXX (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD stress marker ~0.73 (Credit Spread 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. SPY/TLT ~7.82 (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +1.86%) CORRECTION. XLK/XLF level 2.63 (Tech vs Financials 1W: +0.13% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, VXX falling (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) BELOW TREND but Credit Stress rising (Credit Spread 1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. Energy and select cyclicals showing strength — XLE (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +3.92%) CORRECTION — major divergence across SPY/XLK/XLF is the key risk to monitor.
